# Release Planner Memory

v8.1.0 Breeze is a focused-sidebar, airy layout, responsive scaling, and screenshot refresh release.

Release validation must include navigation area/manifest checks, stabilization rules, AI adapter drift checks, release-doc checks, packaging manifest inspection, app flake, targeted mypy, full pytest, coverage, RPM build, screenshot regeneration, and CLI version/help smoke tests.

COPR and workflow build references should use Fedora 44 chroots and containers. Fedora 45 remains preview-only advisory context.
